# domain

```go
import "github.com/ntlaletsi70/blanketops-environments/pkg/githubevent/domain"
```

This file owns the sentinel errors for the GitHubEvent domain. Errors are grouped by concern — structural identity, event semantics, Git context, actor provenance, and lifecycle transitions. Callers use errors.Is to distinguish error kinds without importing provider implementation details.

This file owns the core domain types for the GitHubEvent domain — GitHubEvent, Repository, GitRef, Commit, Actor, and GitHubEventStatus.

GitHubEvent is a pure domain fact: "something happened in a repository." It carries no Kubernetes object references and no policy — those belong to the provider and application layers respectively.

GitHubEventStatus is serialised into the CR's status.contract field by the StatusWriter. It is the authoritative machine\-readable outcome consumed by downstream automation.

This file owns GitHubEventResult — the return type from every GitHubEvent Provider, and the three constructor functions \(Accepted, Triggered, Rejected\) that cover the common outcomes.

GitHubEventResult and GitHubEventStatus share the same fields — ToStatus\(\) converts between them for persistence. The distinction exists so the provider layer operates on a result type and the status layer operates on a status type, keeping their concerns separate.

This file owns the State type — the lifecycle state of a GitHubEvent CR as tracked by the domain layer.

State is intentionally coarse: the domain only cares whether an event is new, has been handled, was deliberately ignored, or errored. Fine\-grained progress is tracked by the provider and surfaced via conditions.

```go
}
```

<a name="GitHubEvent"></a>
## type GitHubEvent

GitHubEvent is the pure domain representation of an observed GitHub webhook event. It is produced by the Mapper and consumed by the Provider.

```go
type GitHubEvent struct {
    EventID    string
    Type       EventType
    Repository Repository
    Ref        GitRef
    Commit     Commit
    Actor      Actor
}
```

<a name="GitHubEventResult"></a>
## type GitHubEventResult

GitHubEventResult is the unified return value from a GitHubEvent Provider.

```go
type GitHubEventResult struct {
    // Accepted indicates the event passed validation and was admitted.
    Accepted bool
    // Triggered indicates the event caused downstream work to be dispatched.
    Triggered bool
    // Message is a human-readable explanation of the outcome.
    Message string
    // TriggeredRef is the name of the downstream resource created, if any.
    TriggeredRef string
}
```

<a name="Accepted"></a>
### func Accepted

```go
func Accepted(msg string) GitHubEventResult
```

Accepted returns a result indicating the event was admitted but did not trigger downstream work.

<a name="Rejected"></a>
### func Rejected

```go
func Rejected(msg string) GitHubEventResult
```

Rejected returns a result indicating the event was not admitted.

<a name="Triggered"></a>
### func Triggered

```go
func Triggered(ref, msg string) GitHubEventResult
```

Triggered returns a result indicating the event was admitted and caused downstream work to be dispatched to ref.

<a name="GitHubEventResult.ToStatus"></a>
### func \(GitHubEventResult\) ToStatus

```go
func (r GitHubEventResult) ToStatus() GitHubEventStatus
```

ToStatus converts a GitHubEventResult to a GitHubEventStatus for persistence. The two types are structurally identical — the conversion is zero\-cost.

<a name="GitHubEventStatus"></a>
## type GitHubEventStatus

GitHubEventStatus is the internal domain status for a GitHubEvent decision. Serialised into the CR's status.contract field by the StatusWriter.

```go
type GitHubEventStatus struct {
    // Accepted indicates the event passed validation and was admitted.
    Accepted bool
    // Triggered indicates the event caused downstream work to be dispatched.
    Triggered bool
    // Message is a human-readable explanation of the outcome.
    Message string
    // TriggeredRef is the name of the downstream resource created, if any.
    TriggeredRef string
}
```

## type GitRef

GitRef represents a Git reference carried by the event.

```go
type GitRef struct {

}
```

## type Repository

```go
type Repository struct {
    FullName string // "owner/name" — the canonical identifier
    Owner    string
    Name     string
}
```

<a name="State"></a>
## type State

State is the lifecycle state of a GitHubEvent.

```go
type State string
```

<a name="StateNew"></a>

```go
const (
    // StateNew — event received, not yet evaluated.
    StateNew State = "New"
    // StateHandled — event was admitted and downstream work was dispatched.
    StateHandled State = "Handled"
    // StateIgnored — event was admitted but no action was required.
    StateIgnored State = "Ignored"
    // StateError — evaluation failed due to a provider or infrastructure error.
    StateError State = "Error"
)
```
